[1/3] Plan: serialize concurrent CLI processes with a stdlib advisory lock on the data directory, resolving the ADR-001 file-locking promise

impact_assessment.why: ADR-001 promises file locking, but StorageEngine only does atomic replace; concurrent CLI processes can lose repository updates through read-modify-write races (Reforge finding .aikit/decisions.md:12)
impact_assessment.benefits: Concurrent chronos commands serialize on one data directory; task/session updates cannot be silently lost; the documented storage contract becomes true
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds StorageEngine.locked/StorageLockError and wraps CLI dispatch, no CLI surface or JSON schema change; dependency: stdlib fcntl/msvcrt only, no new packages; concurrency: exclusive per-data-directory lock with timeout, read-only commands also serialize; state: adds a .lock file beside sessions.json, no state format change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first exclusivity and CLI-wiring tests on both platform branches, 5s timeout with a clear Error/Why/Fix path, full chronos gates via aikit check before commit, ADR-007 recorded
